messageBody:
## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CME (Mars, OSIRIS-APEX, Parker Solar Probe, Solar Orbiter)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-05-16T17:41:21Z
## Message ID: 20240516-AL-005
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

O-type CME detected by STEREO A. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-16T13:38Z.

Estimated speed: ~1081 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 30 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 120/-2 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-16T13:38:00-CME-001

Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is estimated that the CME may impact Mars, OSIRIS-APEX, Parker Solar Probe, and Solar Orbiter (glancing blow). The leading edge of the CME will reach Mars at 2024-05-20T06:40Z, OSIRIS-APEX at 2024-05-18T22:10Z, Parker Solar Probe at 2024-05-18T09:48Z, and the flank of the CME will reach Solar Orbiter at 2024-05-18T13:00Z (plus minus 7 hours).

## Notes: 
Preliminary 3-frame measurement with only available STEREO COR2A data, until SOHO LASCO is available (further analysis will follow). Estimated far-sided longitude of AR 3664 at W120 used, but could range W110-W130.


SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
